verdict.rationale: Cognee exposes explicit remember/recall/improve/forget operations as unified memory CRUD primitives, and ships an official MCP server so agents (Claude, Cursor, Cline, Codex, etc.) can invoke these as tools mid-conversation, plus a CLI/API for programmatic use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually performing add/search/update/delete calls in a live conversation, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm full API surface.
